definitions: A supply of goods kept on hand for sale to customers by a merchant, distributor, or manufacturer.
The capital raised by a business or corporation through the issue and subscription of shares.
The original or principal an individual or family is descended from.
A liquid made by simmering bones, meat, fish, or vegetables in water, used as a basis for soups, sauces, and other dishes.
A person's ancestry or line of descent.
A breed or type of livestock.
The part of a rifle or other firearm to which the barrel and firing mechanism are attached, typically held against the shoulder when firing.
A plant from which cuttings are taken, or onto which a scion is grafted.
A type of fragrant garden flower (Matthiola incana) with dense clusters of flowers.
A wooden frame with holes for securing a person's ankles and sometimes wrists, formerly used for punishment in public.
examples: The shop has a large stock of books.
They come from good farming stock.
She made a rich chicken stock.
The farmer had a healthy stock of cattle.
The gardener prepared the stock for grafting.
The scent of the stock flowers filled the air.
The offender was put in the stocks.
